title: CentPay
description: The CentPay bot gives you plenty of ways to earn money through simple tasks and mini-jobs. You earn Cent coins, which can easily be exchanged for USDT, with a low minimum withdrawal of just $1. Plus, it features a built-in marketplace where you can buy and sell digital goods like gaming accounts and more

title: AINOVUM
description: AINOVUM is a Telegram mining bot that lets you mine for free. You can also top up your account to earn more, and the referral program can help boost your rewards. The bot has been running for months now, and if anything changes or goes wrong, I’ll share updates in my Telegram group or on my X profile

title: CryptOrcs
description: CryptOrcs is a Telegram bot for mining and investing. You can earn $0.10 for free every day, and the minimum withdrawal is $1. You can also invest in the bot, with a minimum deposit of $3, and earn additional rewards through referrals.

title: InvAiEran
description: This investment bot gives you $10 over 5 days, and you can also earn $0.10 for free. The minimum withdrawal is $0.10. You can deposit to earn a percentage profit based on your deposit amount—for example, deposits between $1 and $10 earn 6%. You can also earn extra rewards through referrals.

title: EarnCraft
description: EarnCraft Easy Bot gives you free spins and lets you earn money, with a minimum withdrawal of $1. You can reach the withdrawal amount easily by inviting about 5–6 referrals. You can also earn diamonds by completing tasks, and once you collect 1,000 diamonds, you get an additional spin. Overall, it’s a simple bot to earn from.
